spans.s: स्नपन n. 1. Washing; 2. bathing, ablution, स्नपनविधिविधौ नाहृतं गांगतोयम् Śankara.
स्नापन n. The act of causing to bathe or attending a person while bathing, M.ii.209.
स्नव m. Oozing, dripping.
स्नाव m. A tendon, a muscle.
स्नस् vt. 1P, 4P (pres. स्नसति, स्नस्यति) 1. To eject, to reject; 2. to inhabit.
स्नस्त f. A tendon, a muscle.

स्ना vi. 2P (pp. स्नात; pres. स्नाति; desid. सिष्णासति) 1. To bathe, to perform ablution; 2. to perform the ceremony of bathing when leaving the house of a spiritual preceptor.With अप-, to bathe after mourning.With नि-, to be perfect, to be skilled in, कुतापत्येस्नेहः कुटिलमयनिष्पातमनसाम् M.M.ii.
स्ना Caus. (स्नपयति-ते, स्नापयति-ते) to cause to bathe, to wet, आवर्जिताष्टापदकुंभतोयैः सतूर्यमेनां स्नपयांबभूवुः K.S.vii.10, Megh.i.43.

स्नातक m. 1. A Brāhmaṇa who has performed the ceremony of ablution (required to be performed on his finishing his first Āśrama); 2. a Brāhmaṇa just returned from the house of his preceptor and become a married man; 3. a Brāhmaṇa who is a bhikshu or beggar for any religious object, M.xi.1; 4. any man of the first three classes who is an initiated householder.

स्नान n. 1. Bathing, washing, ablution, घर्मात्तं न तथा सुशीतलजलैः स्नानं न मुक्तावलिः Hit.i.1; 2. purification by bathing, religious or ceremonial ablution; 3. the ceremony of bathing or anointing an idol; 4. anything used in ablution.
स्नान-अगार n. bathroom.
स्नान-द्रोणी f. a bathing tub.
स्नान-यात्रा f. the festival held on the day of full-moon in the month of Jyeshtha.
स्नान-वस्त्र n. a bathing dress.
स्नान-विधि m. the rules of ablution.
स्नानीय (I) a. (f. या) Fit for bathing or ablution, suitable for bathing, स्नानीयवस्त्रक्रियया पत्रोर्णं वोपयुज्यते Mal.v.
स्नानीय (II) n. Water or any other article (such as unguents, perfumes &c.) proper for bathing.
स्नानीय (I) a. (f. या) Fit for bathing or ablution, suitable for bathing, स्नानीयवस्त्रक्रियया पत्रोर्णं वोपयुज्यते Mal.v.
स्नापक m. A servant who supplies bathing water or one who bathes his master.
स्नायु m. 1. A tendon, a muscle, स्नायुग्रंथिनास्थिपंजरजरत्कंकालमालोक्यते M.M.v.; 2. the string of a bow.
स्नाय्वर्मन् n. a kind of disease of the eyes.
स्नायुक m. The same as स्नायु q.v.
स्नाव m. A tendon, a muscle.
